purpose: Repair the shared REG.RU SMTP wire format used by the PC-CROP password-reset path so multilingual transactional mail is emitted as canonical CRLF/base64 MIME with bounded headers instead of 8bit text containing bare LF. The change is transport-only and must not alter reviewer identity, reset-token semantics, MFA, approval, registration roles or authorization.

productBoundary.primaryFlow: PC-CROP reviewer password reset required before 9-role production registration acceptance
productBoundary.sharedTransport: transactional SMTP serialization only; other products may inherit the corrected wire format but no product logic is changed
productBoundary.providerBoundary: existing REG.RU SMTP credentials and provider only

productionEvidence.rootCauseBoundary: current shared SMTP transport emits UTF-8 body as 8bit while product copy is assembled with LF separators

forbiddenChanges: reviewer email disclosure, password handling, reset token generation or expiry
registration role, organization, tenant, approval or cabinet routing semantics
SMTP provider, credentials, DNS, REG.RU mailbox configuration or new infrastructure
Gekta product behavior, entitlement, quota, registration or UI
billing, SMS, payments or new recurring cost
requiredChecks: real password-reset delivery to the reviewer mailbox
reviewer password reset then MFA/TOTP login before the 9-role matrix
maturityBoundary: Completion is not code merge or SMTP acceptance. It requires end-recipient reset receipt, human password reset, MFA/TOTP reviewer login, then the full 9/9 PC-CROP production registration journeys.
